tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Looks up DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA or CAA) for a domain through a public resolver.

tools.name: dns_propagation
tools.description: Asks several public resolvers around the world for the same record and reports whether they agree, which shows whether a DNS change has propagated.

tools.name: dnssec_check
tools.description: Checks whether a domain is signed with DNSSEC and whether its chain of trust (DS and DNSKEY records) is consistent.

tools.name: mx_check
tools.description: Lists the mail servers (MX records) of a domain with their priorities and checks that they resolve.

tools.name: spf_check
tools.description: Reads and validates a domain's SPF record: syntax, the 10-lookup limit, includes and the final policy.

tools.name: dmarc_check
tools.description: Reads and validates a domain's DMARC record: policy, reporting addresses, alignment and percentage.

tools.name: dkim_check
tools.description: Looks up and validates a DKIM public key. Give the selector if you know it; otherwise the common selectors are tried.

tools.name: bimi_check
tools.description: Checks a domain's BIMI record and logo (SVG) for brand indicators in email clients.

tools.name: email_blacklist_check
tools.description: Checks whether a mail server IP address or a domain is listed on public DNS blocklists. Give exactly one of ip or domain.

tools.name: email_deliverability_report
tools.description: Scores a domain's email setup (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI, blocklists) and lists what to fix. Covers the whole email setup in one call, for a general email health question.

tools.name: whois_lookup
tools.description: Looks up a domain's registration data over RDAP: registrar, creation, expiry and update dates, status and nameservers. Not every country code TLD publishes RDAP.

tools.name: hosting_check
tools.description: Finds out who hosts a website: the IP addresses, the network and organisation behind them, the nameservers and any CDN in front.

tools.name: redirect_check
tools.description: Follows a URL's redirects hop by hop and reports each status code, the final address and problems such as loops, long chains or http-to-https gaps.

tools.name: http_headers_check
tools.description: Fetches a page and reports its response headers, with a review of the security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options and others) and cookie flags.

tools.name: website_down_check
tools.description: Checks whether a website is reachable from Cloudflare's network: DNS first, then one request. Separates 'does not resolve' from 'will not connect' and 'answers with an error'.

tools.name: robots_txt_test
tools.description: Fetches a site's robots.txt and tests whether a given crawler may fetch a given path, following RFC 9309. Also lists the Sitemap lines and parser warnings.

tools.name: sitemap_check
tools.description: Finds a site's XML sitemap (from robots.txt or the usual addresses), then validates it against the sitemaps.org protocol and Google's rules. Reads at most 5 MB; a sitemap index is validated as an index, its child sitemaps are listed but not fetched.

tools.name: url_status_check
tools.description: Fetches up to 10 URLs from one site and reports each one's final status code, redirects, content type and X-Robots-Tag. Useful for spot-checking pages listed in a sitemap.

tools.name: ip_lookup
tools.description: Describes a public IP address: the announced prefix and AS number, the network's name, country, registry and the reverse DNS name.

tools.name: asn_lookup
tools.description: Looks up an AS number (like AS13335) in Team Cymru and RDAP: the network's name, organisation, country, registry and registration dates. An IP address is mapped to the AS that announces it first.

tools.name: reverse_dns
tools.description: Finds the PTR (reverse DNS) name of an IP address and checks that the name resolves back to the same address (forward-confirmed reverse DNS), which mail servers look for.

tools.name: ssl_check
tools.description: Makes live TLS connections to a host and reports the certificate chain, expiry, protocol versions, cipher strength and common misconfigurations. Ports 443, 8443, 465, 993 and 995.

tools.name: smtp_test
tools.description: Connects to a domain's mail servers (MX) on port 25, says EHLO, tries STARTTLS and reports banners, TLS and reverse DNS. It never sends mail.

tools.name: dig
tools.description: Sends a DNS query like the dig command, to Cloudflare, Google, Quad9 or a nameserver you name, and returns the full answer with flags and sections. Supports many record types, DNSSEC data and TCP.

tools.name: dns_trace
tools.description: Follows a name from the root servers down through the TLD to its authoritative nameservers, like dig +trace, and shows each delegation step.

tools.name: traceroute
tools.description: Traces the network path from the probe server in Germany to a host, showing each hop's address and round-trip times.

tools.name: http3_test
tools.description: Checks whether a site supports HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 (QUIC): ALPN negotiation, the Alt-Svc header and a live QUIC handshake probe.

tools.name: ttfb_test
tools.description: Times three requests to a web address from the probe server in Germany: DNS, connect, TLS, time to first byte and download. Results are never cached.

tools.name: what_is_my_ip
tools.description: Returns the IP address this request reached the server from, and whether it is IPv4 or IPv6. For desktop clients such as Claude Code or Cursor that is the user's own address; hosted chat apps connect from the provider's servers.

tools.name: subnet_calculator
tools.description: Works out the network, broadcast, host range, netmask and wildcard for an IPv4 or IPv6 address with a prefix, and can split an IPv4 network into equal smaller subnets.

tools.name: bandwidth_calculator
tools.description: Two calculations: monthly data transfer and average speed for a website (visitors, pages per visit, page size), or how long a file takes to move at a given connection speed. Decimal units unless MiB, GiB or TiB are given.

tools.name: chmod_calculator
tools.description: Converts Unix file permissions between octal (755, 4755) and symbolic (rwxr-xr-x) form, shows the chmod command, explains who can read, write and run, and flags risky modes such as 777.

tools.name: uptime_calculator
tools.description: Turns an uptime percentage such as 99.9 into the downtime it allows per day, week, month, quarter and year, or turns a length of downtime in a period into the uptime percentage.

tools.name: cron_expression
tools.description: Reads a classic 5-field cron expression (or @daily, @hourly, @reboot) and returns a plain-English description, the expanded form and the next run times in UTC.

tools.name: punycode_convert
tools.description: Converts international domain names between Unicode and Punycode (xn--) one name at a time, up to 20 names, and warns about mixed-script look-alike names.

tools.name: domain_name_ideas
tools.description: Turns one to three keywords into about 60 domain name ideas (prefixes, suffixes, blends) plus common endings. Ideas only: availability is not checked.

tools.name: spf_record_generator
tools.description: Builds an SPF TXT record from a mail setup: sending IPs, mail providers such as Google or Microsoft, the a and mx mechanisms and soft or hard fail. Returns the record, a DNS lookup estimate and findings.

tools.name: dmarc_record_generator
tools.description: Builds a DMARC TXT record for _dmarc.<domain>: policy, subdomain policy, percentage, report addresses and SPF and DKIM alignment. Returns the record and findings about reporting and policy strength.

tools.name: robots_txt_generator
tools.description: Builds a robots.txt file: allow everything, block everything or custom Allow and Disallow paths, with sitemap URLs, a crawl delay and switches that block AI crawlers such as GPTBot and ClaudeBot. Returns the file and findings.

tools.name: htaccess_generator
tools.description: Builds a commented .htaccess file for Apache and LiteSpeed: force HTTPS, www or non-www, 301 redirects, error pages, security headers, caching, compression and IP blocks. Returns the file text and findings.

tools.name: llms_txt_generator
tools.description: Builds an llms.txt file in the llmstxt.org format from a site name, a summary, details and sections of links. Returns the file text and findings such as duplicate URLs or invalid links.

tools.name: email_header_analyzer
tools.description: Reads the raw headers of an email: the delivery path hop by hop with delays, SPF, DKIM and DMARC results, spam headers and findings. The headers are analysed in memory and are not stored.

tools.name: ssl_certificate_decoder
tools.description: Decodes a pasted PEM certificate or chain: subject, issuer, validity dates, names, key, signature algorithm, fingerprints, extensions and findings, plus a chain order check. Private keys are refused.

tools.name: csr_decoder
tools.description: Decodes a pasted PEM certificate signing request (CSR): subject, names, key type and size, signature algorithm, whether the signature verifies, and findings. Private keys are refused.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bimi_check, email_blacklist_check, redirect_check, http_headers_check, url_status_check, robots_txt_generator · Private data: dns_lookup, dns_propagation, dnssec_check, mx_check, spf_check, dmarc_check, bimi_check, dig, bandwidth_calculator, chmod_calculator, spf_record_generator, dmarc_record_generator, robots_txt_generator, htaccess_generator, llms_txt_generator, ssl_certificate_decoder, csr_decoder · Public sink: bimi_check, email_blacklist_check, email_deliverability_report, reverse_dns, subnet_calculator, email_header_analyzer · Destructive: chmod_calculator, cron_expression, llms_txt_generator.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bimi_check, email_blacklist_check, redirect_check, http_headers_check, url_status_check, robots_txt_generator · Private data: dns_lookup, dns_propagation, dnssec_check, mx_check, spf_check, dmarc_check, bimi_check, dig, bandwidth_calculator, chmod_calculator, spf_record_generator, dmarc_record_generator, robots_txt_generator, htaccess_generator, llms_txt_generator, ssl_certificate_decoder, csr_decoder · Public sink: bimi_check, email_blacklist_check, email_deliverability_report, reverse_dns, subnet_calculator, email_header_analyzer · Destructive: chmod_calculator, cron_expression, llms_txt_generator

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
